# Status: EMPTY BY DESIGN as of 2026-11-06.

# solved with a 0x03 reader that did not consume the value-format byte
# between the u16 property id and the value.  Every live 0x03 item
# therefore under-read by one byte, so the solver was fitting tag/length
# guesses to misaligned bytes: it "proved" e.g. Humanoid.MoveDirectionInternal
# as tag 65 when the schema itself says 22 and the native reader consumes a
# With the format byte parsed (see PropTriple::vfmt), the schema's own tags
# are authoritative and the legacy entries are actively harmful: on the
